bio_am: Ծնած է Երեւան՝ 1863-ին։ Առաջին յեղափոխական կինն էր, որ 1921-ին զոհ գնաց հայ պոլշեւիկներու ոճիրին՝ Ղարաքիլիսէի բանտին մէջ։
bio_en: Natalia Amirkhanian was born in Yerevan in 1863 and educated at the Russian girls' gymnasium in Tiflis, where she took part in the secret meetings of the Narodnaya Volya circles. In 1882, when Armenians formed their own revolutionary groups, she joined an Armenian circle with Tamara Adamian and Miss Katanian and took part in all the secret undertakings in Tiflis; she was involved in the ARF from its organisation in 1890. After Sovietisation the Bolsheviks imprisoned her at Gharakilisa, and in 1921 she was shot together with other ARF prisoners, the first revolutionary woman killed by the Armenian Bolsheviks.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Article by A. Gyulkhandanian.
